label: SpecStream
description: The live web data engine. One platform to build, search, extract, enrich, map, and monitor data across the entire web.
apiKey.label: SpecStream API key
apiKey.description: Keep the key in a Credential Vault locker. Create a key at specstream.ai, under Agents & API.
WebSearch.label: Search the web
WebSearch.description: Answers a question from the live web in seconds with the SpecStream Search API, the most accurate web search API in the world. $5 per 1,000 searches of up to 10 results, or $1 per 1,000 on the fast tier.
WebSearch.return_label: Assign the result to a dictionary variable
WebSearch.return_description: The key "answer" holds the answer. The key "json" holds the complete reply, with every result and its source.
WebSearch.question.label: Question
WebSearch.fast.label: Use the fast tier
ReadPage.label: Read a page
ReadPage.description: Reads the text of a web page, PDF, Word or Excel file live with the SpecStream Extract API. $0.80 per 1,000 pages; a page with no text is not charged.
ReadPage.return_label: Assign the text to a variable
ReadPage.return_description: The text of the page as Markdown.
ReadPage.url.label: URL
